stem.en: In 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O, what does the coefficient 2 in front of H₂ tell you?
stem.et: Võrrandis 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O — mida ütleb kordaja 2 vesiniku ees?

label.en: Two moles of H₂ react per mole of O₂ — a ratio of particles, not of masses
label.et: Kaks mooli H₂ reageerib ühe mooli O₂ kohta — see on osakeste, mitte masside suhe

label.en: Two grams of hydrogen react per gram of oxygen
label.et: Kaks grammi vesinikku reageerib grammi hapniku kohta

label.en: Hydrogen is always consumed completely, whatever the amounts
label.et: Vesinik tarbitakse alati täielikult ära, olenemata kogustest

label.en: Doubling the hydrogen will double the water produced
label.et: Vesiniku kahekordistamine kahekordistab tekkiva vee hulga
